purpose: Motion-refresh variant: cap expensive stereo contour matching to the largest color regions so motion refresh can occur without a multi-hundred-ms frame spike.
expected_effect: Keep candidate_0017 refresh behavior on slow-pan motion.
Reduce refresh-frame p95 by matching only the largest color contour regions.
Preserve enough far rough-distance evidence for large far objects.
risk: Small far contours may lose stereo rough distance when more than eight color regions exist.
Needs slow_pan_far_object and hand_occlusion_reappear replay gates before promotion.
